name: hire-by-ai
description: Round-0 AI Technical Interview System (Monorepo: Frontend + Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit
